Enforced, not reminded

Rules that hold
when the AI forgets.

A rule in CLAUDE.md is a reminder, and a reminder the AI skips is gone. OwnMind wires critical rules into local hooks: no editing a file it has not read, no commit that breaks a rule, and every block is logged.

Blockedbefore the action runs, with a record every time

Memory that travels

Set once.
Remembered everywhere.

Work laptop, home machine, a borrowed one on a trip: every new conversation loads the same preferences, project context and rules. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot share them, so no tool has to be taught again.

1memory, shared by every tool and machine

Team standards

Publish once.
The whole team follows.

A lead publishes a standard in the console and every member's AI loads it in the next conversation. The dashboard shows compliance per rule and per person, and who bypasses rules most often.

Teamone publish, and a new hire is aligned on day one

Your data stays yours

Self-hosted.
Secrets stay out of git.

Memory lives on a server you run, started with one Docker Compose command. An AI that tries to commit an API key or save a password into memory is stopped and pointed to the encrypted vault.

100%of your data on your own server

Three checkpoints, not one plea.

The AI is checked at three moments. None of them depends on it remembering.

CHECKPOINT 01

Conversation starts

Preferences, project context and iron rules are injected, the same in every tool.
CHECKPOINT 02

Before an action

Edits and commands are checked first: editing unread files or committing against a rule is blocked.
CHECKPOINT 03

After a reply

The reply is reviewed for mixed languages, unexplained jargon and leaked personal data, and rewritten until it passes.

Get started

Start the server, then connect each machine. About ten minutes.

Run the server

Start it on your own host with Docker Compose, open the console, create the first admin, and the page shows your key and URL.

git clone https://github.com/miou1107/ownmind.git
cd ownmind
cp .env.example .env   # fill in DB_PASSWORD and the rest
docker compose up -d

Connect a machine

Paste one line into Claude Code or Cursor and the AI installs itself, or run one line in a terminal.

Install OwnMind (my key is YOUR_API_KEY, URL is YOUR_API_URL)

Or in a terminal:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miou1107/ownmind/main/scripts/bootstrap.sh | bash -s -- YOUR_API_KEY YOUR_API_URL

Questions

Is it free?

Yes. MIT-licensed open source, on a server you run. No subscription.

Which AI tools does it work with?

Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and any tool that reads MCP or hooks.

Where do my memory and conversations live?

On the server you run. Each machine talks only to that server, and reaches GitHub only to update itself.

How is it different from CLAUDE.md or .cursorrules?

Those files sit in one project and rely on the AI's discipline. OwnMind keeps rules on a central server, syncs them to every machine, enforces critical ones with hooks, and logs every violation.

Is it made by Anthropic?

No. It is an independent open-source project that works with Claude Code and other AI tools.
